values.note: Online booking closes the day before arrival; for a same-day site call the campground or see the host. Cancel 7+ days out for a refund less $10, 50% at 2-7 days, none inside 2 days.

booking.source: https://wvic.com/Content/Cedar_Falls_Campground.cfm ('Reservations must be made at least 1 day prior to arrival. Reservations are strongly advised, and walk-in or day of rental availability cannot be assured.'; 'Reserve Now!' link to online.premiercampground.com; 'For day-of site rental inquiries ... please call the campground directly'; cancellation policy); CED Rules 2026 PDF ('If you do not have a reservation, see the campground host for availability'), read 2026-11-16

note: Wisconsin Valley Improvement Company (hydro utility) campground at the Cedar Falls dam on the Tomahawk River where it opens into the Willow Flowage, near Hazelhurst, with a boat landing. Sites 9-20 line the water. Outside the season, call the main office at 715-848-2976. --Claude
summary: WVIC pages, rules PDF and 2026 map read: $30 non-electric (sites 9-20) / $40 electric (low was 40 -> 30); season 04-23..10-11 (was approximate 04-20..10-15); 23 nightly sites (count 42 -> 23: 16 seasonal + host excluded); showers, laundry, dump; booking on Premier Campground (operator) closing a day before arrival. Riverfront kept on sites 9-20. 61% of the park's sites are not seasonal; passes long-stay tests.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront kept. The 2026 map colours sites 9-20 'Non-electric Waterfront Site' (and 1-8 'Electric/Waterfront'). On Esri imagery sites 9-14 (~45.7571,-89.8452) sit on open, lightly treed bank 10-30 m from the water, and 15-20 (~45.7567,-89.8458) on the south bank 10-20 m from it, trailers visible on the pads; there the Tomahawk/Willow Flowage arm is ~70 m wide. All 12 are sold nightly ($30). Sites 1-8 face the river below the falls, which is only ~15 m wide - creekside-grade there, so the value rests on 9-20.
PIN fine: stored 45.7588,-89.8466 is at the north overflow lot/garage (same as Google's pin); the loops centre ~45.7577,-89.8462, ~130 m south.
PHONE 715-356-5396 confirmed (in season); WVIC main office (715) 848-2976 year round (kept in the note). WEBSITE confirmed.

LONG-STAY: map marks 16 of 42 sites seasonal (38%) + 1 supervisor; 23-25 sell nights (55-60%) - no caveat needed. Monthly rates exist for 30+ nights. Rate $30-40 passes the gate. Google 4.7 (65). Presence: own page + phone + online booking.
OHV: ATVs/UTVs must stay on the trailer in the campground; separate ATV-trailer parking in the east lot; snowmobile/walking trails pass by. Not a trail base - stays.
